quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #16
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: Car drivers should know that large trucks:

options.text: Can stop faster than passenger vehicles.
Do not need more room to turn than passenger vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Have large blind spots.
questions.explanation: Large trucks have big blind spots in front, on the sides, and in back. Do not stay in these areas. Trucks need more space to turn and stop than passenger vehicles because of their size and weight.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic signal means a ____ light will appear soon.
questions.correctAnswerText: Steady red
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light will appear next.

questions.question: If you stop at a railroad crossing with more than one track:

options.text: Wait until you can see all tracks clearly before going.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go as soon as the train passes.
Go when one track is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see all tracks clearly before going.
questions.explanation: At a crossing with more than one track, do not move as soon as a train passes. Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks. Even at single-track crossings, check again for another train before crossing.

questions.question: Which of the following guides drivers into the proper lanes for turning on some highways?

options.text: White lines on the side of the road
White arrows in the middle of the lanes

questions.correctAnswerText: White arrows in the middle of the lanes
questions.explanation: White arrows on the road show which lanes to use for specific purposes, like going straight or turning.

questions.question: Vehicle stopping distance does NOT depend on:

options.text: The condition of your vehicle's brakes.
The condition and type of your vehicle's tires.

questions.correctAnswerText: The time of day.
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your reaction time, weather, visibility, vehicle weight, brake condition, tire condition and type, road condition, and speed. The time of day does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: When may you proceed through an intersection with a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to check for cross traffic
After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe
After stopping at least 20 feet before the intersection

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe
questions.explanation: Stop before the stop line or crosswalk at any intersection with a stop sign. If there is no stop line or crosswalk, stop before entering the intersection. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic signal means the same thing as:
questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red signal means you must stop and let all other traffic go first.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is coming.

questions.question: Seat belts work best when worn by:

options.text: Everyone in the car every trip.

questions.correctAnswerText: Everyone in the car every trip.
questions.explanation: Everyone in your vehicle should wear a seat belt at all times. In a crash, a person without a seat belt becomes a flying object and can hurt others in the car.

questions.question: At a light rail intersection, always:

options.text: Look both ways before crossing tracks.
Pay attention and obey all traffic signals.
Share the road with pedestrians and bicyclists.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of these.
questions.explanation: Never drive around lowered crossing gates. Always look both ways before crossing train tracks and obey all signs and signals. Trains share the road with cars and bicyclists.

questions.question: What does a red arrow on a traffic light mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly through the intersection.
You must stop and then go when it is safe.
You must stop and wait for a green light or green arrow.
You may turn in the direction the red arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stop and wait for a green light or green arrow.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means you must stop completely. Wait until the light changes to green or a green arrow appears before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road is joining from the right ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road is joining from the right ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road will join from the right at an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What must you do when you see a red traffic light?
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: A red light means stop. You must stop at the stop line, before any crosswalk, and before entering the intersection.

questions.question: How much does an instruction permit cost?
questions.explanation: An instruction permit costs $3.50. This permit lets young drivers (age 15+) practice driving with a licensed adult supervising. Test fees are separate.

questions.question: Why does driving at night require extra care?

options.text: There are more cars on the road at night.
You cannot see as well at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see as well at night.
questions.explanation: It is dark at night, so visibility is poor. You must use your headlights from 30 minutes after sunset until 30 minutes before sunrise, or anytime you cannot see clearly for 500 feet.

questions.question: How should you safely pass a bicycle?

options.text: Honk to alert the bicyclist you are passing.
Drive in the bicycle lane to get around them.
Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
Speed up and pass quickly in front of them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
questions.explanation: Slow down and give bicycles plenty of space. Bicyclists are not protected like car drivers. Passing too fast or too close can cause them to lose control.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: Go through if no other cars are coming.
Keep going because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light marks a dangerous intersection. Always treat it the same way you would treat a stop sign—come to a complete stop.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spot before changing lanes?

options.text: Look in your left side mirror.
Look in your right side mirror.
Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.
questions.explanation: Always look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move. This lets you see vehicles in your blind spot that mirrors cannot show.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road you are on ends ahead.
You must turn either right or left.
A road is joining from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. The road splits, and you must choose to bear either right or left.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: Driving too slowly can be illegal if it disrupts the normal flow of traffic. You can be cited for driving slower than conditions allow.

questions.question: What affects how alcohol impacts your body?

options.text: How much food is in your stomach
How much time passes between drinks

questions.correctAnswerText: All three choices
questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol level depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Food in your stomach slows alcohol absorption, but it cannot prevent intoxication if you drink too much.

questions.question: As alcohol builds up in your blood, it:

options.text: Breaks down faster in your body

questions.correctAnswerText: Slows down your reactions
questions.explanation: As alcohol builds up in your system, it slows your reactions, makes you feel more confident, and causes you to make more driving mistakes.

questions.question: If another car is about to hit you, what should you do?
questions.correctAnswerText: Sound your horn
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians who may not see you. For example, sound your horn if you think another driver is about to hit you.

questions.question: Turning your head to check your blind spot before changing lanes or merging is:

options.text: Not necessary if you use your rearview mirror

questions.correctAnswerText: A good driving habit
questions.explanation: When changing lanes, check your blind spots by looking over your shoulder toward the next lane. Do not rely only on your mirrors.

questions.question: What does a single dashed yellow line between traffic mean?

options.text: Drivers may pass if it is safe
Both lanes travel in the same direction
Drivers may pass, even if dangerous

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers may pass if it is safe
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A single dashed yellow line means vehicles in both directions can pass. You may only pass if you will not interfere with oncoming traffic.
